Sourcing Our sourcing strategy is to maintain a flexible, globally-diversified, cost-efficient third-party manufacturing base. We source our inventory production from multiple third-party manufacturers, primarily in: • Vietnam for the Crocs Brand. We have additional third-party manufacturers in China, Indonesia, India, and Mexico, among other countries. During the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, approximately 45%, 51%, and 56%, respectively, of our Crocs Brand production was in Vietnam.
